key.name: camera
key.description: Which phone camera to use: 'back' or 'front'.

key.name: device
key.description: Serial number of the phone (ro.serialno), set by the tile menu. Leave empty to use the first connected phone.

key.name: serial
key.description: Exact adb serial to use, as listed by 'adb devices'. When set it overrides 'device'. Leave empty to let the tile menu choose.
